title: Chemex Pour-Over Glass Coffeemaker - Classic Series - 8-Cup - Exclusive Packaging

reviews.body: Not only does the best-tasting coffee I’ve ever had in my life come from this thing, but it’s also so much more beautiful in appearance to have on your countertop than a typical plastic pot. It pours well, it’s heavy duty, it’s perfect.

I absolutely love it. Between ease of setup and use, the size of it allowing me to brew a good amount of coffee in one shot, and it works with literally any filter cones you can get, it's as close to the perfect pour over system you can get without spending a silly amount of money.
